patch_description: The champion's weakest metric is noise_reduction (0.37) while correlation is excellent (0.88). The Gen 78 recommendation: in `_threshold_details`, the noise-dominated branch (mag < 0.5) currently applies soft-threshold then a mild 0.5× shrink, leaving residual noise in fine scales. Switch to full hard-thresholding: zero all coefficients below the universal threshold entirely (soft-threshold already gives exactly that for |c| < thr — the additional 0.5× multiplier is what leaves residual noise in surviving coefficients). Additionally tighten the threshold multiplier from 0.75 to 0.85 so more fine-scale noise is captured, while keeping signal-bearing scales untouched (zero-phase, correlation-safe). The slope_changes/false_reversals metrics should also improve since residual fine-scale noise is what drives spurious reversals. Atomic co-sweep as recommended.
